nodes.name: Main Entrance Gate
nodes.description: Primary campus entrance with security kiosk, visitor registration, and campus shuttle stop.

nodes.name: Administrative Block
nodes.description: Houses the Dean of Academics, Registrar, Admissions Office, and Student Welfare Board.

nodes.name: Grand University Auditorium
nodes.description: 1,200 seat performance auditorium for convocations, symposiums, and cultural events.

nodes.name: Central Library & Commons
nodes.description: Four-story learning commons with digital media labs, 24/7 reading halls, and journal archives.

nodes.name: Student Activity Center & Food Court
nodes.description: Hub for student clubs, indoor games, cafeteria, and student union council office.

nodes.name: Sports Arena & Gymnasium
nodes.description: Indoor basketball courts, Olympic badminton stadium, fitness gym, and athletics track.

nodes.name: Turing Engineering Tower
nodes.description: Seven-story tower for Computer Science & Software Engineering, LH-101, LH-102, and faculty cabins.

nodes.name: Ramanujan Science Complex
nodes.description: Houses Mathematics, Data Science, Quantum Computing Center, and Lecture Hall LH-201.

nodes.name: Tesla Electrical Wing
nodes.description: Department of Electrical & Electronics Engineering, Embedded Systems Lab, and LH-103.

nodes.name: Newton Heavy Engineering Wing
nodes.description: Mechanical and Aerospace engineering laboratories, wind tunnel, and tutorial rooms.

edges.description: Walk north along the Palm Boulevard avenue towards the Admin Block.
Turn right past the entrance fountain towards the Grand Auditorium.
Proceed northeast across the Central Quadrangle walkway to the Library.
Walk north on Cedar Path towards the Student Activity Center.
Head northwest along the landscaped promenade directly to the Library.
Walk northeast along East Ring Road towards Ramanujan Complex.
Take the covered west canopy walkway straight into the Sports Arena.
Cross Southeast Lawn footpath to enter the Library west entrance.
Walk north along the Tech Plaza paved walkway towards Turing Tower.
Take the Science Walkway heading east towards Ramanujan Science Complex.
Cross the North Courtyard overbridge connecting to Tesla Electrical Wing.
Walk northeast past the Robotics Annex towards Newton Heavy Engineering.
Walk south-southeast along the central academic breezeway.
Walk east along Engineering High Street connecting Tesla and Newton wings.
